about: Loop-header bound table for text_budget.py. Each rule: regex on the loop header text (whitespace-normalized, string contents blanked), a bound expression over the D1 count symbols, and the reason. Bound 0 means the loop iterates a collection that D1 forces empty (DOMAIN.md clause cited). First matching rule wins. G4: RV83 R-2 (ruled: price it) removes the validate_profile and build_pressure_case_with_members exclusions; their sites are priced at their multiplicity. G4 (RV84 S-2): broad zero rules anchored; specific rules for real local tables placed first; text_budget lists every zero-matched header (zero_matched_headers) for review. G4: the result_export exclusion is dropped; the precommit reader (T17) is on the Direct path at b1f80234dc and its text is counted here. | G5 R-4: one rule added (final_case.rs:317), loop_bounds.r4.json
